newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Killer of Ethiopian army officer sentenced to die.
newsitem.headline: Killer of Ethiopian army officer sentenced to die.

text.p: Ethiopia's Federal High Court has sentenced to death an Eritrean businessman who shot dead a senior military officer outside a hotel in the capital Addis Ababa last year, state television reported on Saturday.

The court on Friday found Jamal Yasin Muhammad guilty of the murder of Major-General Hayelom Araya -- a former deputy defence minister and head of operations -- in Addis Ababa on 14 February 1996, according to the television. Jamal has 10 days to appeal.
Under Ethiopian laws, the death sentence is administered by hanging or firing squad.

Jamal's two sisters, charged with complicity to murder, were freed. The death sentence takes effect after it is endorsed by the Horn of African country's president. It was not known when that would happen, lawyers said.
The television report gave no more details.

Hayelom was a leading figure in the campaign to end 17 years of Marxist rule in Ethiopia and saw his efforts rewarded with the ousting of dictator Mengistu Haile Mariam and the setting up of a democratic government in 1991.
